ValidationRule.description: PL1 to PL3. Salesforce checks a sales process only in the page layout; this rule makes every save, including the API, respect the stage list of the deal's pipeline.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: CASE(RecordType.DeveloperName, "New_Clients", CASE(TEXT(StageName), "New lead", 1, "Qualification in chat", 1, "Warm-up", 1, "Key call scheduled", 1, "Key call confirmed", 1, "Key call held", 1, "Closing", 1, "Prepayment received", 1, "Payment received", 1, "Handed over to preparation", 1, "Conditional refusal", 1, "Closed Won", 1, "Closed Lost", 1, 0), "Reactivation", CASE(TEXT(StageName), "Deferred demand", 1, "Waiting for next period", 1, "Ignored", 1, "Regular touches", 1, "Dialogue resumed", 1, "Closed Lost", 1, 0), "Repeat_Sales", CASE(TEXT(StageName), "Building the base", 1, "Announcement and pre-registration", 1, "Clarifying the situation", 1, "Key call scheduled", 1, "Closed Lost", 1, 0), 1) = 0
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This stage is not in the deal's pipeline. Pick one of the pipeline's stages, or move the deal to the other pipeline first.
